marketing-display.purpose: Public root marketing only; operational UI retains its own scale.

marketing-display-mobile.purpose: Widths through 399px; inherits weight 650 and line height 0.98 from the hero.

marketing-headline.purpose: Explanatory marketing sections, never operational dashboards or checkout.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Modal elevation; marketing sections remain flat.

motion.name: control-fast
motion.purpose: Existing primary and secondary button color transitions.

motion.name: welcome-expand
motion.purpose: Source .welcome-main-photo: clip-path inset(0 6% round 32px) to inset(0 0 round 32px); only supported browsers from 800px with no reduced-motion preference.

motion.name: chapter-stack
motion.purpose: Source .menu-chapter: native sticky panels, static through 799px width, through 650px viewport height, and with reduced motion. All content visible by default.

motion.name: logo-drift
motion.purpose: Six explicitly fictional example venue brands, never customer references. Pause/resume control and hover pause the track; reduced motion shows all six in a static grid, hiding the duplicate list and pause control. Duplicated content is aria-hidden.

components.name: Marketing primary action
components.description: One dominant registration or task action.
components.css: .ds-control { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:12px 20px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:999px; font:600 16px/1.25 "League Spartan", Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 120ms,border-color 120ms; } .ds-primary { background:var(--zk-action, #000); color:var(--zk-action-fg, #fff); } .ds-primary:hover { background:var(--zk-neutral-900, #171717); } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--zk-focus, #000); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-control { transition:none; } }

components.name: Marketing secondary action
components.description: Secondary controls such as the header login pill and mobile navigation.
components.css: .ds-control { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:12px 20px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:999px; font:600 16px/1.25 "League Spartan", Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 120ms,border-color 120ms; } .ds-secondary { background:var(--zk-surface, #fff); color:var(--zk-text, #000); border-color:var(--zk-border-strong, #d4d4d4); } .ds-secondary:hover { background:var(--zk-surface-muted, #fafafa); } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--zk-focus, #000); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-control { transition:none; } }

components.name: Product image placeholder
components.description: Text-only future capture, transparent inside a Citron chapter; the staff variant uses a muted surface. No fabricated product UI.
components.css: .ds-placeholder { margin:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:24px; min-height:420px; padding:40px; border:1px dashed var(--zk-color-ref-citron-700, #506e00); border-radius:24px; color:var(--zk-text, #000); text-align:center; font-family:"League Spartan", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-placeholder p { margin:0; font-size:24px; line-height:1.25; max-width:24ch; font-weight:500; } .ds-placeholder figcaption { font-size:14px; font-weight:500; } @media (max-width:1100px) { .ds-placeholder { padding:24px; } } @media (max-width:799px) { .ds-placeholder { min-height:300px; } }

components.name: Public navigation link
components.description: Visible text navigation with an underline on hover and a distinct keyboard outline.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:32px; font-family:"League Spartan", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color:var(--zk-text, #000); padding:12px 0; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a:hover { text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:.2em; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--zk-focus, #000); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Inline explanatory link
components.description: A secondary text destination within explanatory content.
components.css: .ds-inline-link { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:12px 0; font:600 16px/1.5 "League Spartan", Arial, sans-serif; color:var(--zk-link, #000); text-underline-offset:.2em; } .ds-inline-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--zk-focus, #000); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Footer text link
components.description: Footer links and the privacy-settings text button use plain text at rest and underline on hover on the Citron surface.
components.css: .ds-footer-link { display:inline-block; padding-block:12px; font:400 14px/1.5 "League Spartan", Arial, sans-serif; color:var(--zk-text, #000); text-decoration:none; } .ds-footer-link:hover { text-decoration:underline; } .ds-footer-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--zk-focus, #000); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview: Zackisch adds optional browser-based QR ordering and payments to existing hospitality workflows. Table service and counter pickup are both supported. The restaurant keeps its POS and service choices; guests do not need an app/account.
keyCharacteristics: League Spartan across marketing and app.
Unchanged black wordmark and signet; only the public footer wordmark uses owner-authorized CSS opacity 0.22.

rules.name: The Marketing Scope Rule
rules.body: Larger display typography belongs to the public website's explanatory hierarchy; keep the operational UI scale unchanged. Headings wrap naturally, without fixed-height text containers. Body copy retains a maximum 65-character measure where the layout permits; long legal text uses a narrower 760px article container. Test the actual translation at 320px and with enlarged text.

rules.name: The Visible Motion Rule
rules.body: Scroll enhancements begin from visible content. On the public website, desktop-only photo clipping is progressive enhancement; reduced-motion mode disables animations, transitions and sticky chapter panels. No content depends on animation support or scroll position to become readable.

rules.name: The Footer Logo Exception Rule
rules.body: Only the public footer presents the unchanged original black wordmark at CSS opacity 0.22 on Electric Citron, with 16px side margins and 8px bottom padding. Other logo placements remain opaque black.

dos: Use real color stock photographs with verified free commercial rights; no optional attribution captions. Keep provenance.
Keep product image areas clearly text-labelled until actual screenshots are available.

Header country trigger matches the login secondary pill and forms a 12px-gap group with it; footer country trigger retains its transparent Citron treatment. Label fictional logo band with Demo-Lokale / Demo venues.
Right-align the personal contact block; email uses no arrow and underlines on hover or keyboard focus.
Footer: three columns, country trigger first above unheaded navigation, then contact/help and legal. Below 900px the first group spans the row above the remaining two.
donts: Never recolor or recreate the supplied logo artwork.
Never invent screenshots, endorsements or commercial claims.
